{{Top}}
[[File:Broadband_antenna.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], picking up an overpowering transmission from [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on his broadband antenna.]]
A '''broadband antenna''' was a communications device that was capable of monitoring all broadcast and communications frequencies.<ref name="J7">{{JournalCite|7|The History of R-Series Astromech Droids}}</ref> [[Droid/Legends|Droids]] fitted with broadband antennas could receive transmissions directly from other droids.<ref name="AGTSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droids]] such as the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO series]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] such as the [[R5-series astromech droid]] were fitted with broadband antennas and receivers. [[Fromm Tower Droid]]s used their broadband antenna to guide its [[repulsor ball]]s, and to receive commands from a central command post.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Broadband antennas could also be fitted to [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]]; [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] had a broadband antenna installed in his [[Armor/Legends|armor's]] helmet that allowed him to intercept and unscramble [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] communications traffic.<ref name="BobaFettArmor">{{StoryCite|story=Boba Fett's Armor: An Essential Guide to a Walking Weapon|book=Star Wars: Boba Fett}}</ref>
